sources.snippet: Why This LoRA? This is the first multi-angle camera control LoRA for Qwen-Image-Edit-2511. While Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 has built-in viewpoint capabilities, this LoRA provides: 96 precise camera poses - Exact control over camera position 3000+ training pairs - Massive dataset for maximum accuracy Gaussian Splatting data - 3D-consistent training for better spatial understanding Low-angle ...

sources.title: Qwen-Image Edit 2511 Multiple Angles | Layer Docs
sources.snippet: Qwen-Image Edit 2511 Multiple Angles pairs the Qwen image editing model with the Multiple Angles LoRA to regenerate the same subject from a different camera angle. Drive it with Layer’s orbit-camera controls to rotate horizontally, tilt vertically, and zoom — ideal for producing turnaround views and consistent multi-angle game assets from a single reference image.
